settings.title: Your dog doesn’t always show when they’re in pain

settings.text:
Discolored teeth and bad breath aren't just unpleasant – they can be signs of tartar, plaque, and inflammation.

And just like you want to protect your child, you want to protect your dog.

But unlike children, most dogs don’t show when they’re in pain.

FreshWipes from VetPets give you an easy way to care for your dog’s oral health – without vet visits, stress, or uncertainty.

FreshWipes gently clean your dog’s teeth and gums.

Removes plaque, freshens breath, and prevents inflammation.

All in one small, simple wipe you slip on your finger.

No toothbrush, no mess, no stress.

settings.title: A simple habit that makes a big difference

settings.text:
Many dog owners think dental care has to be complicated.

But with FreshWipes, it’s so easy that you’ll actually use them.

1–2 times a week is all it takes to prevent painful problems in the future.

Fresh breath, stronger teeth, happier dog

A healthy mouth affects the whole body.

With FreshWipes, your dog not only gets fresher breath and whiter teeth –

they’ll also feel better and have more energy.

Fewer infections. More play. More joy.

Veterinary cleaning for tartar can cost thousands of kroner and often requires anesthesia.

FreshWipes cost a fraction – and are completely risk-free to use

For us, it’s not about making money – it's about helping dogs feel better.

Gentle. Safe. Developed for your dog.

Our wipes are fragrance-free, pH-balanced, and designed for safe use in the mouth.

They fit all dog breeds and are easy to bring on walks, trips, or holidays.

Dental care should never be a barrier.

settings.title: Tea Polyphenols
settings.text: Tea polyphenols are natural antioxidants that help reduce bacteria in the mouth, freshen breath, and protect the gums from inflammation.

settings.title: Glycerin
settings.text: Glycerin moisturizes the oral mucosa and gums – reducing the risk of irritation and providing gentler cleaning..

settings.title: Citric Acid
settings.text: Citric acid helps balance the pH level in the mouth – which protects tissues and prevents bad breath.

settings.title: Allantoin
settings.text: Allantoin protects and soothes sensitive gums. Helps reduce irritation and promotes healing.

settings.title: Cetylpyridinium Chloride
settings.text: A well-known antibacterial ingredient used in oral care. Helps reduce plaque, bacteria, and bad breath.

settings.title: Sodium Benzoate
settings.text: A gentle and safe preservative that extends shelf life without affecting the mouth’s sensitive environment.

settings.heading: Is this 100% safe for my pet?
settings.row_content:
✅ Yes! The wipes are made to be as gentle as they are effective.

They are free from:

  • ❌ Alcohol

  • ❌ Parabens

  • ❌ Essential oils (which can irritate some pets)

  • ❌ Harsh chemicals or artificial fragrances

Our formula is developed with veterinary insight to ensure safety for both dogs and cats – even those with sensitive gums or skin.

settings.heading: How do I use the product?
settings.row_content:
Slip the wipe over your finger.

  1. Gently rub along your pet’s teeth and gums in circular motions.

  2. Focus especially on the gum line and any areas with visible plaque or discoloration.

No toothbrush. No mess. No stress.

Use daily or 1–2 times a week for best results.

settings.heading: Is this a substitute for toothbrushing?
settings.row_content:
For most pet owners: yes.

Brushing is best – but often unrealistic in everyday life.

FreshWipes provides a simple and reliable way to care for your pet’s oral health – without the struggle.

settings.heading: What’s in the formula?
settings.row_content:
Only what your pet needs – nothing more.

Every ingredient is carefully selected to support safe and effective oral care:

  • Purified water – gentle base that adds moisture
  • Aloe vera – soothes gums and helps reduce irritation
  • Natural plant extracts – provide antibacterial protection
  • Zinc compounds – freshen breath and fight plaque
  • pH-balanced & fragrance-free – safe for sensitive pets
  • Cruelty-free – never tested on animals
  • No alcohol, fluoride, or harsh chemicals

Just safe, simple, and effective dental care – in every wipe.

settings.heading: When can I expect results?
settings.row_content:
🦷 Fresh breath? In just a few days.

🦷 Cleaner teeth and healthier gums? 2–3 weeks with regular use.

Hold tight – your pet’s mouth will thank you!

settings.heading: Is FreshWipes suitable for all breeds and sizes?
settings.row_content: Yes, the wipes are flexible and work well for everything from small toy breeds to large dogs – and for cats.

settings.heading: Do the wipes help with bad breath?
settings.row_content: Yes! Antibacterial ingredients and natural breath-fresheners help reduce plaque and bad odor.

settings.heading: How should I store FreshWipes?
settings.row_content: Store the container in a cool, dry place. Avoid direct sunlight to maintain moisture in the wipes.
